fields.serialInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid serial number. Check the label on the product and try again.
fields.purchaseDateFuture: Purchase date can't be in the future.

fields.tooManyFiles: You can attach up to {{maxFiles}} files.
fields.batchHelp: Printed next to the serial, for example 2514-L03.

auth.resetSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.

auth.registerLink: Bought a Fieldpiece product? Register it

check.title: Check warranty
check.intro: Enter the serial number to see if a product is covered.
check.notFound: Serial number not found. Check the label on the back of the product, or register it first.
check.signInToClaim: You'll need to sign in to file a claim.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noneExpiring: No warranties end in the next 30 days.

registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.empty: No registrations yet. Register a product to start its warranty.

claims.title: Warranty claims
claims.searchPlaceholder: Search claim, serial, batch or customer
claims.noEvidence: No photos, videos or receipts attached.
claims.noneForUnit: No claims filed on this product.
claims.pickUnitFirst: Pick the product to see whether its warranty covers the claim.
claims.descriptionHelp: What happens, when it started, and what you've tried.
claims.evidenceHint: Photos, a short video or the receipt, up to 3 files
claims.approveHelp: Choose how it will be settled. The claimant is notified.

closeHelp.REPAIR: Close it once the repaired product is on its way back to the customer.
closeHelp.REPLACE: Enter the serial of the replacement product. It's registered to the same customer with the rest of the original warranty.
closeHelp.CREDIT: The credit is posted to Finance when you close the claim.

org.title: Dealers & users
org.distributorIn: Distributor in {{city}}, {{count}} dealers. Its login sees all of them.
org.directHelp: These dealers report to the brand directly.

simulate.title: System events
simulate.intro: Messages from the systems that send registrations to the warranty platform: a distributor's ERP sales feed, the registration mailbox and an online marketplace.

intake.title: Registrations from systems
intake.help: The distributor ERP sends a sales invoice with 3 serials and a customer emails a receipt to the registration mailbox; both wait in the Registration inbox for review. A marketplace sends 2 orders through the partner API, registered at once.

reset.title: Reset data
reset.help: Put every screen back to the starting data.
reset.confirmHelp: Everything done since the last reset is removed. Everyone stays signed in.

validation.serial: That doesn't look like a valid serial number. Check the label on the product.
validation.email: Enter a valid email, like name@company.com.
validation.invoiceRequired: Add a photo or PDF of the receipt or invoice.
validation.voidReason: Choose why the warranty is void.
validation.amount: Enter a credit amount between $0.01 and $100,000.
validation.issueType: Choose what's wrong with the product.
validation.resolution: Choose how the claim will be settled.
validation.state: Use the two-letter state code, for example TX.

rowErrors.invalid_serial: Not a valid serial for this model
rowErrors.unknown_model: Model not in the product catalog

rowErrors.invalid_batch: Not a valid batch number for this model

units.title: Registered products
units.searchPlaceholder: Search serial, batch, model, customer or dealer
units.empty: No products match. Clear the filters or register a product.
units.notRegisteredLong: This product isn't registered yet. Its warranty starts from the purchase date once the registration is approved.

void.title: Void this warranty?
void.help: The product loses its warranty. New claims on it aren't covered and open ones are re-checked. The reason, your name and the date are recorded.
void.noteHelp: What was found, for example signs the meter was opened.

units.term: 1 year from the date of purchase
units.covers: Defects in materials and workmanship. Not covered: misuse, physical damage, unauthorized repair, batteries and normal wear.

myUnits.empty: No products yet. Scan the QR code on your product to register it.
myUnits.pendingLine: Sent on {{date}}. Your warranty starts once it's approved.

models.title: Product catalog
models.empty: No products in the catalog yet.
models.labelFormatHelp: Every registration of this model is checked against these formats.
models.serialDefault: 9 digits: year, week, then a 5-digit sequence (e.g. 251406233)
models.batchDefault: Year and week, then the line (e.g. 2514-L03)
models.viewProducts: Show registered products of this model

inbox.title: Registration inbox
inbox.searchPlaceholder: Search serial, batch, customer or dealer
inbox.empty: No registrations match. Clear the filters.

review.duplicateWarning: Serial {{serial}} is already registered. Compare with the existing record below, then reject or merge.
review.modelMismatchWarning: The model on this registration doesn't match the model in our records for this serial.
review.unknownSerialWarning: This serial isn't in our shipment records. Check it against the receipt.

registerUnit.doneMessage: The warranty is active from the purchase date.
registerUnit.reviewMessage: This serial is already registered, so the warranty desk checks it before anything changes.
registerUnit.purchaseDateHelp: The warranty runs for 1 year from this date.
registerUnit.warrantyPreview_one: Warranty: {{count}} month from the purchase date.
registerUnit.warrantyPreview_other: Warranty: {{count}} months from the purchase date.

selfRegister.fromQr: Details read from the QR label on your product.
selfRegister.pendingMessage: Pending approval: we check your receipt, then your warranty starts from the purchase date. You'll get a notification.
selfRegister.placeOfPurchaseHelp: Store or website, for example the dealer's name.

bulk.title: Bulk import
bulk.dropHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 5 MB. Use the template columns: serial, batch, model, purchase date and customer.
bulk.summary: {{total}} rows checked: {{registered}} registered, {{errors}} need fixing, {{review}} sent to the warranty desk.

qr.pointCamera: Point the camera at the QR code on the product's label.
qr.cameraBlocked: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or type the serial below.
qr.cameraInsecure: The camera only works on a secure (https) page. Type the serial below instead.
qr.cameraUnavailable: No camera available. Type the serial below.
qr.unreadable: That QR code isn't a product label. Try again or type the serial.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.bulk_processed: {{file}}: {{registered}} registered, {{errors}} to fix, {{review}} sent to the warranty desk.
notifications.unit_voided: The warranty on {{serial}} is void. Open the product to see why.

coverage.title: Warranty coverage
coverage.covered: In warranty until {{date}}. The claim is covered.
coverage.EXPIRED: The warranty ended on {{date}}. The warranty desk can still review the claim, but it isn't covered.
coverage.VOID: The warranty on this product is void, so the claim isn't covered.
coverage.NOT_REGISTERED: This product isn't registered yet. Register it first.
coverage.terms: Fieldpiece products carry a 1-year warranty from the date of purchase against defects in materials and workmanship.

publicRegister.title: Register your Fieldpiece product
publicRegister.intro: Register your tool to keep a record of its 1-year warranty and make warranty claims faster. You don't need an account.
publicRegister.sentMessage: We check your receipt and email you when your warranty is confirmed.

hub.title: Registration channels
hub.intro: Every way a product registration reaches the warranty desk. Dealer, bulk and partner registrations are approved at once when they pass the catalog checks; registrations from buyers are reviewed first.

dealer.title: At the counter
dealer.help: Register a product when you sell it: scan the QR label or type the serial and batch number, then add the customer.

bulk.title: Bulk upload
bulk.help: Upload a week's sales as an Excel or CSV file. Rows with problems are fixed on screen and resubmitted.

web.title: Website form
web.help: Buyers register on the website without an account, with a photo of the receipt. Link to it from your site, receipts or packaging.
web.qrAlt: QR code for the registration form
web.qrHelp: Print this QR code on receipts or counter displays.

email.title: By email
email.help: Buyers email the receipt to the registration mailbox. The serial, model and date are read from the invoice and the registration waits for review.

portal.title: Customer portal
portal.help: Signed-in customers scan the QR label on the product and register it from their phone.

partner.title: Partner API
partner.help: Point-of-sale systems, distributor ERPs and online marketplaces send registrations to the partner API. Ask the warranty desk for an API key.
partner.helpAdmin: Point-of-sale systems, distributor ERPs and online marketplaces send registrations to the partner API with their own key. Add and manage the keys below.

partners.title: Partner systems
partners.help: Each partner system has its own API key. Registrations it sends are tagged with its channel and, when set, its dealer.
partners.addHelp: The API key is shown once, after you create it.
partners.keyHelp: It won't be shown again. Send it to the partner over a secure channel.
partners.channelHelp: Partner API for point of sale, Marketplace for online stores, Distributor ERP for sales feeds.
partners.dealerHelp: Registrations are credited to this dealer. Leave empty for marketplaces.
